newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 8.

text.p: * American Brands Inc said it has decided to spin off its British-based Gallaher Tobacco in the next 6-10 months. The company said also said it would change its name to Fortune Brands and consider repurchasing up to 10 million shares after the spin-off. Shares closed at 44-1/2.
* Motorola reported third quarter earnings of $0.34 per share versus $0.81 last year. The company also said cost-cutting efforts will hurt its fourth quarter results. Shares closed at 49-3/4.

* McDermott International Inc said its second quarter loss will exceed the $0.18 per share it lost in the first quarter and said it planned to cut its quarterly dividend to $0.05 per share from $0.25. Shares closed at 22.
* Lukens Inc said it expects to report a loss of $0.26 to $0.33 per share in its third quarter. The company cited low stainless steel prices. Shares closed at 18.
* Advanced Micro Devices Inc reported a third quarter loss of $0.28 per share, narrower than the $0.36 Wall Street expected, versus a profit of $0.30 last year. Shares closed at 15-3/4.
* Mothers Work Inc said it expects to lose $0.50 to $0.60 per share in its fourth quarter. Shares closed at 11-3/4.
